site.title: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.heading: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.description: Rose Hallgren is an architect and designer in Stockholm, KTH-trained and awarded Ung Svensk Arkitektur 2023, working with transformation, housing and craft.
site.intro:
I am an architect and designer in Stockholm. I work between drawing and making: a house in the archipelago, a stage set, a tufted wall, a glazed vessel.

What interests me is the point where a plan has to become a material decision. Weaving and ceramics are not finishes applied at the end. They are how I work out what a space should be.

Much of my current work runs through wool and wood. I showed wool as a building material at the Copenhagen Architecture Biennial, with Axfoundation and the Nordic Wool Initiative. The wood runs from prefabricated houses drawn for the factory to the Torö addition, which was awarded Ung Svensk Arkitektur 2023.

I trained at KTH and took housing from city-scale proposals to full construction drawings at Anders Berensson Architects. I model in Rhino and Blender, and I photograph and scan the buildings I work with.

Together with Jenny Hedén Malm I run Fanfaluca Collective. I am one of four behind C.O.U.A., and I also work with the lighting collective Svartljus and Kulturföreningen PLX. My studio is at Åsögatan 122 in Stockholm, shared with SMASH and collaborator Jonas Johansson.
